# runpod_global_volume (Data Source)

A single global volume looked up by identifier. Global volumes are usage-billed storage that is not tied to a data center.

**If you are an AI agent:** set up through https://agents.runpod.io first, then follow
[Using the provider from an AI agent](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/runpod/runpod/latest/docs/guides/agent-setup) before you plan or apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_global_volume" "training_data" {
  id = "gsb_abc"
}

output "global_volume_name" {
  description = "Name of the global volume."
  value       = data.runpod_global_volume.training_data.name
}

output "global_volume_created_at" {
  description = "When the global volume was created, in RFC 3339 format."
  value       = data.runpod_global_volume.training_data.created_at
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
[use-case modules](https://github.com/runpod/terraform-provider-runpod/tree/main/v2/modules);
the Guides section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Global volume identifier.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the volume was created, in RFC 3339 format.
- `created_by_user_id` (String) Identifier of the user who created the volume; null when the API has no creator recorded.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name; not unique.
